questions.questionText: Which measure is most useful for comparing the efficiency of two farm enterprises that use different amounts of variable inputs?

options.text: Gross margin per unit of limiting resource

questions.explanation: Gross margin per unit of a limiting resource allows enterprises to be compared where resources such as land, labour or capital are constrained.

questions.questionText: Which soil property most directly determines the soil's ability to resist a rapid change in pH when acid or alkali is added?
questions.explanation: Buffering capacity is the resistance of a soil to changes in pH.

questions.questionText: What is the main significance of stomatal opening in crop physiology?

options.text: It regulates gas exchange and water loss

questions.explanation: Stomata regulate CO2 entry for photosynthesis and water-vapour loss through transpiration.

questions.questionText: Which breeding strategy is most directly used to combine desirable traits from two genetically different parent lines?
questions.explanation: Hybridisation crosses genetically different parents to combine traits in offspring.

questions.questionText: Why is an economic threshold used in integrated pest management?

options.text: To avoid unnecessary control costs when pest damage is below an economically important level

questions.explanation: The threshold supports economically justified intervention rather than automatic pesticide application.

questions.questionText: What does heritability describe in quantitative genetics?

options.text: The number of genes in an animal
The proportion of observed phenotypic variation attributable to genetic variation in a specified population and environment

questions.explanation: Heritability is a population statistic describing the genetic contribution to phenotypic variance under specified conditions.

questions.questionText: Which amino-acid-related concept is central when assessing the quality of protein in a monogastric animal diet?
questions.explanation: The limiting essential amino acid constrains the utilisation of other amino acids for protein synthesis.

questions.questionText: Which hormone is strongly associated with milk ejection in a lactating mammal?
questions.explanation: Oxytocin stimulates contraction of myoepithelial cells, causing milk ejection.

questions.questionText: What is a major advantage of including a well-managed legume in a pasture system?

options.text: Biological nitrogen fixation can increase nitrogen inputs

questions.explanation: Legumes can fix atmospheric nitrogen in symbiosis with compatible bacteria, contributing nitrogen to the system.

questions.questionText: Why is matching tractor power to an implement important?

options.text: It improves field efficiency and reduces unnecessary fuel use and machine stress
It removes the need for calibration

questions.explanation: Correct matching improves power utilisation, work rate, fuel efficiency and machine longevity.

questions.questionText: Which market function adds value by making produce more uniform in quality and presentation before sale?
questions.explanation: Grading and standardisation classify produce according to defined quality characteristics, supporting market transactions.

questions.questionText: If an enterprise has gross income of $24,000 and variable costs of $14,500, what is its gross margin?
Which soil-management practice most directly improves infiltration while reducing erosion and preserving surface residue?
questions.explanation: Reduced disturbance and residue retention protect the surface and can improve infiltration and soil structure.

questions.questionText: Which climatic variable is especially useful when estimating evaporative demand of a crop?
questions.explanation: Temperature and humidity strongly influence atmospheric evaporative demand; wind and radiation are also important.

questions.questionText: Which feature of a well-designed agricultural experiment most directly improves the ability to separate treatment effects from random variation?
questions.explanation: Replication estimates experimental variation while randomisation reduces systematic allocation bias.

questions.questionText: What does a soil's Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) measure?

options.text: Ability of negatively charged clay and humus colloids to hold and exchange basic cations (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺, NH₄⁺)

questions.explanation: High humus and 2:1 clay (montmorillonite) increase CEC, boosting nutrient retention against leaching.

questions.questionText: Why is 2:1 expanding clay (montmorillonite, found in black vertisols of Chisumbanje) sticky when wet and deeply cracked when dry?

options.text: Water enters between loosely bonded silica-alumina-silica sheets causing dramatic swelling and shrinking

questions.explanation: Vertisol smectite clays expand and contract markedly with moisture changes.

questions.questionText: Under Zimbabwe's Indigenisation and Land Reform policy, what is A2 commercial farming aimed at?

options.text: Medium-to-large scale commercial farm enterprises run as business units with farm plans

questions.explanation: A1 models support smallholder/villagised resettlement while A2 targets commercial-scale business farms.

questions.questionText: In farm linear programming / production economics, at what input level is profit maximised for a single variable input (say nitrogen X yielding maize Y)?

options.text: Where Average Physical Product is maximum
Where Total Fixed Cost equals zero
Where Total Physical Product begins to fall
Where Marginal Value Product (MVP) equals Marginal Factor Cost (MFC)

questions.explanation: Marginal profit is zero and total profit maximised when MVP = P_y · MPP = P_x.

questions.questionText: Which type of genetic interaction occurs when one gene locus masks or modifies the phenotypic expression of a gene at a different locus (e.g., coat colour in cattle)?
questions.explanation: Epistasis involves non-allelic gene interaction masking another locus.

questions.questionText: In C₃ vs C₄ crop physiology, why does maize outperform wheat under high midday temperatures and intense sunlight in Zimbabwe?

options.text: Maize avoids photorespiration via PEP carboxylase carbon-concentrating bundle sheath anatomy

questions.explanation: C₄ plants concentrate CO₂ in bundle-sheath cells, raising water-use efficiency and high-temp growth.

questions.questionText: What is the function of the rumen volatile fatty acid "propionic acid" compared with acetic acid in dairy nutrition?

options.text: Propionic acid promotes high milk butterfat % exclusively
Propionic acid is glucogenic (liver converts it to glucose/lactose driving milk yield volume)

questions.explanation: High-concentrate diets raise propionate → glucose → higher milk volume, whereas roughage acetate boosts butterfat %.

questions.questionText: Which irrigation scheduling parameter tells a farm manager when available soil moisture has dropped to the refill point before crop stress?

options.text: Field capacity minus permanent wilting point divided by 2 (50% Readily Available Water depletion)

questions.explanation: Irrigating when Readily Available Water (RAW) reaches threshold prevents stomatal closure and yield loss.

questions.questionText: In agro-forestry systems like alley cropping maize between Leucaena leucocephala rows, how do the tree rows improve maize sustainability?

options.text: They fix atmospheric nitrogen, cycle deep subsoil minerals via leaf prunings, and check slope erosion
They shade out all sunlight permanently

questions.explanation: Deep-rooted leguminous trees act as nutrient pumps, green-manure mulch, and wind/water barriers.

questions.questionText: What does a Net Present Value (NPV > 0) indicate when evaluating a $50,000 centre-pivot irrigation investment?

options.text: The project loses money and should be rejected
Discounted future cash inflows exceed the initial capital cost at the chosen hurdle rate — project adds net wealth
Internal Rate of Return is negative

questions.explanation: Positive NPV means return exceeds cost of capital -> financially viable.

questions.questionText: Which soil pH range maximises availability of most essential macronutrients and micronutrients in arable Zimbabwean loams?
questions.explanation: Slightly acidic to near-neutral pH prevents Al³⁺/Mn²⁺ toxicity and phosphorus fixation.

questions.questionText: Which oestrous synchronisation hormone in beef cattle (AI programmes) causes regression (luteolysis) of the corpus luteum so cows come into heat together?
questions.explanation: PGF₂α lyses the corpus luteum, dropping progesterone so a new follicular wave ovulates predictably.

questions.questionText: In post-harvest physiology, why does storing apples or tomatoes with ripe bananas hasten spoilage?

options.text: Ripe climacteric fruit emits ethylene (ethene) gas triggering rapid ripening and senescence

questions.explanation: Ethylene hormone accelerates climacteric respiration and softening.

questions.questionText: Which soil conservation parameter in the Universal Soil Loss Equation (A = R·K·L·S·C·P) can a farmer change directly in a single season?

options.text: C (crop cover/mulch management) and P (conservation practices like contours)
Regional slope length of the mountain

questions.explanation: Mulching, cover crops (C) and contour ridging/terracing (P) directly cut soil erosion A.

questions.questionText: What distinguishes a cooperative marketing board from a private commodity middleman?

options.text: Cooperatives pay zero returns to farmer members
Member-farmers jointly own the cooperative, pool bulk transport/inputs, and share surplus patronage bonuses

questions.explanation: Agricultural cooperatives aggregate farmer bargaining power and return profits to member patrons.

questions.questionText: What causes "bloat" (ruminal tympany) in cattle grazing lush young lucerne pastures?

options.text: Stable proteinaceous foam traps fermentation gases (CO₂/CH₄) preventing eructation (belching)

questions.explanation: Frothy bloat swells the left paralumbar fossa and compresses lungs unless treated with antifoaming oil/trocar.

questions.questionText: In hybrid maize seed production (e.g., SC 513), why must female parent rows be detasselled before pollen shed?

options.text: To prevent self-pollination so female silks receive pollen strictly from the chosen male parent line

questions.explanation: Detasselling female lines ensures 100% F₁ hybrid cross-pollination.

questions.questionText: Which soil organism converts toxic ammonia/ammonium from urea into plant-available nitrate ions?
questions.explanation: Nitrification oxidises NH₄⁺ → NO₂⁻ → NO₃⁻ aerobically.

questions.questionText: In broiler nutrition, what is meant by Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR = 1.7)?

options.text: 1.7 kg of meat produces 1 kg of feed
Birds drink 1.7 L water per week
1.7 kg of feed is consumed to gain 1.0 kg of live body weight

questions.explanation: Lower FCR represents superior feed efficiency and lower production cost per kg.

questions.questionText: Which tillage implement breaks deep compacted plough pans without inverting the surface mulch layer?
questions.explanation: Subsoilers fracture dense hardpans at 35–50 cm depth to restore root penetration and drainage.
